function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

Shashi Tej Reddy is a former Indian Army officer who transitioned into business and philanthropy after his military service.  
He served in the Indian Army’s Special Forces (Para SF) before retiring from active duty. After leaving the army, he founded **Shashi Tej Reddy & Co.**, a diversified investment firm that operates across several sectors including real estate, infrastructure, and technology.  

Beyond his corporate ventures, Reddy is known for his charitable work. He established the **Shashi Tej Reddy Foundation**, which focuses on improving access to quality education and healthcare in underserved communities. The foundation runs scholarship programs, builds schools, and supports medical outreach initiatives.  

In addition to his business and philanthropic pursuits, Reddy has been involved in community development projects and has received recognition for his contributions to both the defense sector and social welfare.
